english: The vehicle speed always stays below 120 mph (AT1).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Stated as G[0,20] from the start; taken as an invariant. Max observed speed is 50 mph, so it holds with a large margin.

english: The engine speed always stays below 4750 rpm (AT2).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Violated on 1 of 40 runs (max 4754.9 rpm): not a property of the model under these inputs.

english: After a shift into gear 1, the transmission stays in gear 1 for at least 2.5 s (AT51).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Falsified on the generated runs (1 violation).

english: After a shift into gear 2, the transmission stays in gear 2 for at least 2.5 s (AT52).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Falsified on the generated runs (4 violations).

english: After a shift into gear 3, the transmission stays in gear 3 for at least 2.5 s (AT53).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Falsified on the generated runs (26 violations).

english: After a shift into gear 4, the transmission stays in gear 4 for at least 2.5 s (AT54).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Needs G in the consequent, which SLAM develop cannot mine (..G.., f_STLG).

english: If the engine speed stays below 3000 rpm for 30 s, the vehicle speed stays below 35 mph for the first 4 s (AT6a).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Only checkable at the start of each 30 s run. Needs G in the antecedent, which SLAM develop cannot mine (only ..F..).

english: If the engine speed stays below 3000 rpm for 30 s, the vehicle speed stays below 50 mph for the first 8 s (AT6b).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Only checkable at the start of each 30 s run. Needs G in the antecedent, which SLAM develop cannot mine (only ..F..).

english: If the engine speed stays below 3000 rpm for 30 s, the vehicle speed stays below 65 mph for the first 20 s (AT6c).
note: ARCH-COMP AT (sldemo_autotrans), discretised at 0.1 s per sample. Only checkable at the start of each 30 s run. Needs G in the antecedent, which SLAM develop cannot mine (only ..F..).

english: In fault-free operation the fuel controller keeps the air-fuel ratio close to the stoichiometric value 14.6 (14 <= AFR <= 15.2).
note: sldemo_fuelsys (Model a Fault-Tolerant Fuel Control System), fault-free runs, 0.1 s per sample. Band chosen as 14.6 +- 0.6; observed 14.12-14.81.

english: In fault-free operation fuel is always injected (the engine is never shut down).
note: sldemo_fuelsys (Model a Fault-Tolerant Fuel Control System), fault-free runs, 0.1 s per sample. Shutdown (fuel = 0) only happens with multiple sensor failures.

english: When the throttle opens (by more than 0.5 deg in 0.1 s), the manifold pressure increases within 0.2 s.
note: sldemo_fuelsys (Model a Fault-Tolerant Fuel Control System), fault-free runs, 0.1 s per sample.

english: When the throttle closes (by more than 0.5 deg in 0.1 s), the fuel rate decreases within 0.3 s.
note: sldemo_fuelsys (Model a Fault-Tolerant Fuel Control System), fault-free runs, 0.1 s per sample.

english: While the vehicle moves fast (vs > 10), the ABS keeps the relative wheel slip at or below 0.3, preventing wheel lock-up.
note: sldemo_absbrake (Modeling an Anti-Lock Braking System), ABS on, 0.05 s per sample; vs/ww are vehicle/wheel speeds in angular-velocity units. The controller targets slip 0.2.

english: Once braking has built up slip (slip >= 0.1), the vehicle decelerates while it is moving (vs > 1).
note: sldemo_absbrake (Modeling an Anti-Lock Braking System), ABS on, 0.05 s per sample; vs/ww are vehicle/wheel speeds in angular-velocity units.

english: While the vehicle is moving (vs > 1), the stopping distance increases.
note: sldemo_absbrake (Modeling an Anti-Lock Braking System), ABS on, 0.05 s per sample; vs/ww are vehicle/wheel speeds in angular-velocity units.

english: The wheel never rotates faster than the vehicle-equivalent speed (ww <= vs).
note: sldemo_absbrake (Modeling an Anti-Lock Braking System), ABS on, 0.05 s per sample; vs/ww are vehicle/wheel speeds in angular-velocity units. Compares two signals: outside the fragment of G (as App. D.4). Also violated in the first 0.2 s.

english: The thermostat keeps the indoor temperature within 5 F of the 70 F set point.
note: sldemo_househeat (Thermal Model of a House), set point 70 F, 60 s per sample.

english: When the indoor temperature falls to 65 F (set point - 5 F), the heater turns on within 2 minutes.
note: sldemo_househeat (Thermal Model of a House), set point 70 F, 60 s per sample. Relay with +-5 F hysteresis.

english: When the indoor temperature reaches 75 F (set point + 5 F), the heater turns off within 1 minute.
note: sldemo_househeat (Thermal Model of a House), set point 70 F, 60 s per sample.

english: No heating cost accrues while the heater stays off.
note: sldemo_househeat (Thermal Model of a House), set point 70 F, 60 s per sample.
